description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to the Ocdm component within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. It includes class declarations for OcdmFactory and Ocdm, with methods for obtaining Ocdm instances and checking support for key systems.

classes.name: OcdmFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing Ocdm instances, including a singleton pattern with thread safety.

classes.name: Ocdm
classes.description: Implementation of the IOcdm interface, representing the Ocdm component with support checking functionality.

methods.name: OcdmFactory::getOcdm
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to an IOcdm instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Ocdm::isTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system type is supported by this Ocdm instance.
